instagram_carousel.caption:
Which March are you booking? For a wedding abroad, March is a shoulder month, so the real question is which kind of shoulder you want.

Our new guide, Wedding Destinations in March for Spring or Autumn Weddings, covers ten unranked places we plan in, grouped by what the month means in each place.

Early spring in Europe
The Greek islands, Lake Como, the Amalfi Coast, the French Riviera and Portugal. A long lunch outdoors and dinner indoors. March nights are cool at every official station in the guide, so heating, wraps and an indoor room belong in the plan.

Autumn and late summer in the south
New Zealand brings settled autumn spells, though one storm can change a week. Mauritius, the Seychelles, Bali and Fiji bring heat, inside the wet, cyclone or monsoon season Smartraveller describes, so a covered ceremony option and a buffer day are part of the booking.

Questions worth asking any venue
Is the venue open and fully staffed on your March date?
What is the covered or indoor plan, and how late on the day can you switch to it?
How do older guests get between spaces when paths are wet?

Torn between a cool European spring and a warm, wet island? Message us to weigh the two with a Wedded Advisor. Full guide at the link in bio.
